2057. Update Employee Salary

60

Medium

Write a Java program to simulate updating an employee's salary in a database.

The program should read N employee records. Then read:

Employee ID
New salary

If the employee exists, update the salary and display:

Salary updated successfully

If the employee does not exist, display:

Employee not found
output_spec:
